The “Attract Abundance and Wealth” Meditation utilizes Agesta’s sacred codes to spark positive changes in your life. For noticeable improvements, commit to practicing this meditation for 9, 15, or 21 days.

For quicker results, it is highly recommended that you first complete the “Inner Cleanse” meditation sessions.

Sacred codes are numerical sequences believed to connect individuals with higher frequencies, manifest intentions, and support healing. Introduced by channellers such as Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), these numbers are said to originate from beings of light and function as a spiritual technology to elevate human consciousness.

To use a sacred code, simply repeat the numerical sequence—either mentally or aloud—while in a meditative state. Blending numerology, meditation, and energy healing, these codes have earned many positive testimonials. Whether applied for manifestation, healing, or spiritual growth, they continue to be a fascinating tool in modern esoteric practices.
